name: intraday_trend_following_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms are working directional orders over 10-20 minute windows, they create a persistent EMA alignment visible as the 2-minute EMA sustaining itself above the 10-minute EMA. Brief pullbacks to the 2-minute EMA represent moments where short-term momentum sellers exhaust against resting institutional limit bids placed just below the recent micro-mean. At 5-second resolution, we detect the precise bar where NIFTY close returns above EMA(24) after the dip — signaling the institutional absorption has re-engaged — and ride the next 8-15 NIFTY spot points of continuation before the institutional order fill cycle completes.
core_signal_oneliner: EMA(24) pullback and bounce with 10-minute EMA trend alignment and VWAP above-filter
